name: Groombridge 34 A
description: A nearby red dwarf, 39% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 15A: radius in solar radii, 0.3863 +/- 0.0021, from the weighted mean of the interferometric measurements the table lists

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 15A: mass 0.423 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 15A: effective temperature in K, 3567 +/- 11, from the weighted mean of the interferometric measurements the table lists

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 39% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.3863 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,567 K.
